correctness.rationale: The Bernoulli augmentation coupling K~Bin(n,x), U~Bernoulli(x) takes X=K/n and Y=(K+U)/(n+1). Direct conditioning gives E|X-Y|=2x(1-x)/(n+1). Each path moves from a degree-n trough to an adjacent degree-(n+1) tent peak. The explicit continuous tent spline has slope +1 on [j/n,(j+1)/(n+1)] and -1 on [(j+1)/(n+1),(j+1)/n], so h(Y)-h(X)=|X-Y| on every atom and coupling is W1 optimal by its matching 1-Lipschitz witness. At any interior x all 2(n+1) atoms have positive probability. Equality in the two triangle inequalities forces the same oriented maximal increment on every adjacent interlacing interval; endpoint saturation then forces linearity between knots, giving exactly +/-h plus constants, including n=1. Independent rational arithmetic reconstructed cumulative-distribution W1 for n=1..9 at x=2/5, matching the formula, and source verify_bernstein.py checks 184 rational instances; neither finite check substitutes for the coupling proof.
